Hello @Timothy Berry ,

Thank you for providing the screenshots. We can see that the search returns results in the application, however, the completed Excel export shows 0 results.

To assist with our investigation, could you please confirm the following:

  • Does this issue occur with all searches/exports or only with this specific search?

  • When did you first notice this issue?

  • Are any other users experiencing the same behavior?

Thank you for your assistance.

Regards,

Appriss Retail Support

I hope you are doing well. I wanted to follow up regarding the issue where Excel exports were returning 0 results. Could you please let us know if you are still experiencing this problem?

Regards,
Viraj Kansara
Appriss Retail Support
